Name: Gus to August Dialogue and Gender change
Author: upforkilling
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]This mod changes Gus into August and changes their gender to Female.
It also adds more dialogue I have given August 11 new lines of Heart level related Daily Dialogues. Being in the Salon changes what  Daily they have, I never knew that until making this mod.
Best enjoyed with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40777]Gus Girl Mod[/url] It will work without it, but why would you use it... [/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Place unzipped mod in mods folder [/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Gender and name swap.
11 new lines of Hear level Daily Dialogue. [/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Content Patcher
SMAPI - Stardew Modding API [/color]
